start: HQ opened in Chrome on an Android phone, not installed

steps.action: Look at the top bar
user_sees: The MettleUp HQ name and an 'Install app' button
must_not: The button on a phone where HQ is already installed

steps.action: Tap 'Install app' and accept the browser's install question
user_sees: HQ added to the home screen; the button hidden
must_not: The button still shown after install
A second install question at once

steps.action: Open HQ from the home screen icon
user_sees: HQ full screen with the bottom bar
must_not: A sign-in loop on first open

start: HQ opened in Safari on an iPhone

steps.action: Tap 'Install app'
user_sees: The hint 'Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.'
must_not: Nothing happening on tap

steps.action: Tap 'Install app' again
user_sees: The hint hidden
must_not: The hint stuck over the page

start: HQ on a phone, on Needs you

steps.action: Tap 'More' on the bottom bar
user_sees: The full menu slides up from the bottom with a dark cover behind
must_not: The sheet opening under the bottom bar

steps.action: Tap 'Leads' in the sheet
user_sees: The sheet closes and Leads opens
must_not: The sheet left open over the new page

steps.action: Open More again, tap the dark cover
user_sees: The sheet closes; the page unchanged
must_not: A page opened by the tap on the cover

start: Installed HQ on a phone with no internet

steps.action: Open HQ from the home screen
user_sees: Page 'You're offline.', 'HQ needs the internet.' and 'Try again'
must_not: Old gym data shown from memory
The browser's own dinosaur error page

steps.action: Turn the internet on, tap 'Try again'
user_sees: HQ opens normally
must_not: The offline page stuck after the internet is back

steps.action: Decline the browser's install question on Android
user_sees: The 'Install app' button hidden until the browser offers again
must_not: The button left on screen doing nothing

tests.checks: s1 see: the offline page says "You're offline." and "HQ needs the internet."; s1 not: the service worker never stores an answer or a page
s1 see: the offline page says "You're offline." and "HQ needs the internet."; s1 not: the service worker never stores an answer or a page

start: HQ on a phone with the More sheet open

steps.action: Tap 'More' again
user_sees: The sheet closes
must_not: The sheet stuck open

steps.action: Install HQ, then open it from the browser tab too
user_sees: No 'Install app' button in either
must_not: The install button shown inside the installed app

start: HQ installed on a phone that someone else may pick up

steps.action: Turn the internet off and open HQ
user_sees: Only the plain offline page
must_not: Any gym, member, lead or payment kept on the phone by the installed app

tests.checks: s1 see: page loads fall back to the offline page only; s1 not: the only cache writes are the three offline files
s1 not: the page keeps nothing in browser storage
